question: 一共有多少名学生？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM students;

question: 所有学生的平均 GPA 是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gpa), 4) AS avg_gpa FROM students;

question: 列出 GPA 排名前 5 的学生姓名、学号和 GPA。
reference_sql: SELECT name, student_no, gpa FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询所有学分大于或等于 3.5 的课程名称和学分。
reference_sql: SELECT title, credits FROM courses WHERE credits >= 3.5;

question: 统计各个学籍状态的学生人数。
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY status;

question: 查询 2024 年发放的奖学金总金额和获奖人次。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM scholarships WHERE award_year = 2024;

question: 统计每个学院的学生人数和平均 GPA。
reference_sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count, ROUND(AVG(s.gpa), 4) AS avg_gpa FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.id = s.department_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;

question: 查询每位教师讲授的课程数量和总学分，只保留授课门数不少于 1 门的教授。
reference_sql: SELECT i.name AS instructor_name, COUNT(c.id) AS course_count, SUM(c.credits) AS total_credits FROM instructors i JOIN courses c ON i.id = c.instructor_id WHERE i.title = '教授' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 1;

question: 统计每门课程的选课人数、平均分和最高分，按平均分降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT c.title AS course_title, COUNT(e.id) AS enroll_count, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score, MAX(e.score) AS max_score FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY avg_score DESC, c.id ASC;

question: 查询获得过奖学金的学生的姓名、所属学院以及累计奖学金总额。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, d.name AS department_name, SUM(sc.amount) AS total_scholarship FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id JOIN scholarships sc ON s.id = sc.student_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, d.name;

question: 找出平均成绩高于 88 分且选课门数至少为 2 门的学生姓名和平均成绩。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(e.id) >= 2 AND AVG(e.score) > 88;

question: 统计各个学院学生的校园已支付消费总金额，按总金额从高到低排序。
reference_sql: SELECT d.name AS department_name, ROUND(SUM(co.amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.id = s.department_id JOIN campus_orders co ON s.id = co.student_id WHERE co.payment_status = '已支付' GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: 查询计算机科学与技术学院所有在读学生的姓名、学号和 GPA。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name, s.student_no, s.gpa FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '计算机科学与技术' AND s.status = '在读';

question: 列出所有必修课程的课程代码、名称及授课教师姓名和职称。
reference_sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, i.name AS instructor_name, i.title AS instructor_title FROM courses c JOIN instructors i ON c.instructor_id = i.id WHERE c.course_type = '必修';

question: 统计校园消费订单中已支付订单按消费类别的订单数和总金额。
reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM campus_orders WHERE payment_status = '已支付' GROUP BY category;

question: 查询选课状态为补考或重修的学生姓名、课程名称、学期和成绩。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, c.title AS course_title, e.semester, e.score FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.status IN ('补考', '重修');

question: 统计不同职称教师的人数分布。
reference_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS instructor_count FROM instructors GROUP BY title;

question: 使用 CTE 查询每个学院 GPA 排名第一的学生姓名、学院名称和 GPA。
reference_sql: WITH ranked_students AS (SELECT s.name AS student_name, d.name AS department_name, s.gpa, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.department_id ORDER BY s.gpa DESC) AS rnk FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id) SELECT student_name, department_name, gpa FROM ranked_students WHERE rnk = 1;

question: 查询 GPA 高于其所属学院平均 GPA 的学生姓名、学院名称、个人 GPA 以及学院平均 GPA。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, d.name AS department_name, s.gpa, ROUND(dept_avg.avg_gpa, 4) AS dept_avg_gpa FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id JOIN (SELECT department_id, AVG(gpa) AS avg_gpa FROM students GROUP BY department_id) dept_avg ON s.department_id = dept_avg.department_id WHERE s.gpa > dept_avg.avg_gpa;

question: 找出既获得过奖学金、又有至少一笔已支付图书类校园消费订单的学生姓名及奖学金总额。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, SUM(sc.amount) AS total_scholarship FROM students s JOIN scholarships sc ON s.id = sc.student_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campus_orders co WHERE co.student_id = s.id AND co.category = '图书' AND co.payment_status = '已支付') GROUP BY s.id, s.name;

question: 计算每个消费类别的已支付金额占所有已支付校园消费总金额的百分比（保留两位小数）。
reference_sql: WITH paid_orders AS (SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS cat_total FROM campus_orders WHERE payment_status = '已支付' GROUP BY category), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(cat_total) AS total_amount FROM paid_orders) SELECT p.category, ROUND(p.cat_total, 2) AS category_amount, ROUND(p.cat_total * 100.0 / g.total_amount, 2) AS pct FROM paid_orders p CROSS JOIN grand_total g;

question: 查询从未获得过任何奖学金但选修课程平均分高于 80 分的学生姓名、所属学院和选课平均分。
reference_sql: SELECT s.name AS student_name, d.name AS department_name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id JOIN enrollments e ON s.id = e.student_id WHERE s.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM scholarships) GROUP BY s.id, s.name, d.name HAVING AVG(e.score) > 80;
